_doc: Temporal / state-change retrieval benchmark: a fact that CHANGED over time. The KB records three successive decisions for the same fact (the daemon's deploy target: fly.io -> render -> railway), each superseding the prior WITHOUT deleting it. Each query asserts which note SHOULD be retrieved -- either the fact current NOW (default) or the fact current AT a past instant (as-of). Scorer-compatible: every query carries `relevant` (gold note labels) so a recall@k / MRR scorer ranks `results[].title` against it. `as_of` null => current-only retrieval.
